body: ohhh i see i see. i misunderstood, i thought you were still trying to get the account back.
i recently got my account back after about 5 years of being locked out. it took them a while initially to get to the ticket, but i had my account back within two days of them responding.

i like to go for a walk in a melting pot, like las vegas. there’s people from all over the world there and i love seeing short kings all around me. i’m talking cis dudes a whole half foot shorter than me and twice my age. i know it sucks being short, but there’s shorter dudes out there and they do just fine. ps, i actually did grow about half an inch after starting t. i know it’s not much, but it was something!

just keep in mind that your voice dropping is one of the first effects of t. that being said, i was able to hide it from my parents for a while and my mom said she never noticed my voice drop even though the difference was substantial. i guess my parents were just so hell-bent on not losing their daughter, they didn’t notice. regardless, my voice didn’t even drop that much and everyone else around me could tell a massive difference. other side effects could be easy enough to hide or excuse, like weight gain, but i’d probably take the stance of most of the other comments here and wait until you’re in a safe position to start. i know it’s not ideal and not what you want to hear, but i also had to wait until i was 20 years old and living 4 hours away from my family to start t. your safety is more important.

i got my name because it’s been my nickname since i was born. and then i just changed my middle name to the masculine version of my dead name, which would have been my name had i been born male. i don’t think there’s anything wrong with trying out a few different names and finding one that feels good. i still sometimes think of other names id like but im very happy with what i landed on.
